provenance.inputs: Real rainfall and soil moisture (Open-Meteo reanalysis/forecast)
provenance.downstream_systems: SIMULATED infrastructure network response (not real sensor hardware)
provenance.disclaimer: This real-event run is illustrative and exploratory. Numbers must not be interpreted as operational field trials.

negative_controls.small_sample_caveat: Sample size too small for false-alarm rate (n=1 event). Counts reported directly without extrapolation.

labels_detail.anchor_rationale: Dikhow crossed highest flood level at Sivasagar; Betbari and Santak fully submerged.
Simaluguri station tracks, yard, and railway colony flooded; train services cancelled or diverted.
Eight major embankment breaches in the Jorhat region; Selengahat inundated.
NH-37 (NH-715) submerged near Teok; traffic halted; advisory issued for Guwahati-Dibrugarh highway.
Nazira tea-estate hospitals flooded; medical staff isolated; emergency childbirths in factory quarters.
Disang surge from Mon hills batters Charaideo (170 mm rain, 21 deaths, 8,300 ha crop lost).
Dhansiri (South) above danger mark at Numaligarh; bridge collapse; 70,000 affected in August wave.
Urban flooding hits Guwahati; North Guwahati wards 1, 4, 5, 6 flooded; 62 SDRF rescue boats deployed.
